briefing: Field Report from Agent Polaris: Multiple cases of fraud have been reported in Minnesota, including a daycare closing amid fraud allegations and viral video exposure, and concerns over Medicaid fraud. A freeze on $10 billion in childcare funding has been implemented, with concerns over fraud in Minnesota. Further investigation is warranted to uncover the extent of the fraud and who is responsible.
